title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.23339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）推理与传统的LLM服务存在显著差异，其特点是输入序列长、束搜索宽度大，而输出仅有少量固定的token。现有的LLM服务引擎（如vLLM）将各条束作为批处理中的独立序列来处理，导致对共享提示前缀的KV缓存产生冗余访问。此外，vLLM将束搜索的每一步生成作为单独的引擎调用来执行，从而在解码步骤之间引入了主机侧的束处理开销，并在PagedAttention中进行大量的运行时KV块管理。利用Tree Attention，我们沿序列维度将各条束拼接起来，以消除冗余的KV访问，并进一步通过预生成的部分注意力掩码、静态KV缓存分配、循环展开的生成调度、TorchAir图编译、自动算子融合以及词表约束解码来优化执行。在不使用自定义内核的情况下，我们的方法（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用Tree Attention将束搜索的各条束沿序列维度拼接以消除冗余KV缓存访问，并结合静态KV缓存分配、图编译、算子融合与词表约束解码等系统优化，在不依赖自定义内核的前提下大幅提升了生成式推荐推理中束搜索的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper optimizes beam search for generative recommendation inference by using Tree Attention to concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV cache accesses, combined with static KV cache allocation, graph compilation, operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding—achieving major efficiency gains without custom kernels.
